wholePhysicalScope: Three mapped building envelopes and the mapped rose garden at Sixth and Safford. The 1882 hall’s entry faces Sixth Street and the other two face Safford.
lodDetails: Four levels retain all three historic buildings and the rose trellis. Near levels add roof ribs, porch and accessibility rails, stained glazing, and branches under the trellis.
limitations: The March 2015 photos establish the 1947 and 1881 street fronts, the 1882 hall entrance, and the rose trellis. Exact window tracery, decorative detail and rear openings remain approximate.
The 1882 hall and side additions share an irregular mapped outline. Their roof joint, kitchen openings and minor details are reconstructed from the mapped mass and the parish description.
Original elevations are unchanged. Individual thresholds, the low approach ramp and the rose beds use approximate contact with the composite source field.
